models.name: Lynx Smart BMS 500 (LYN034160200 M8 / LYN034160210 M10)

sharedMapEvidence: Two models, one map, on the strength of the record's own vendor-assigned name: the Victron BLE specification's record-type table calls 0x0A '(Lynx Smart) BMS'. That is the vendor naming the Lynx Smart BMS product by name against a record layout — the one place in that entire document where a Victron product line is named rather than a device category. The 500 A and 1000 A variants are covered by O
gotchas: The record is named for the Lynx Smart BMS, but the specification is dated 2022-12-14 and the Lynx Smart BMS NG (LYN034160310 / LYN034170310) did not exist then. Do NOT assume an NG unit emits 0x0A — see the unknown-victron-ble-instant-readout entry.
Battery current at bit 72 is signed 0.1 A. The SOC at bit 122 is 10 bits, not 8 or 16 — a byte-aligned parse silently misreads it.
Consumed Ah is stored positive and negated on read (vendor remark: 'Consumed Ah = -Record value'). Reading it straight gives the wrong sign.
Temperature is offset-encoded: value = record − 40. Reading it raw reports a frozen bank as +40 °C above truth.
Same commissioning cost as every Instant Readout record: per-device AES key from VictronConnect after pairing, and Instant readout is off by default.
unmappedReports: VE_REG_BMS_ERROR (8-bit error code) — no MetricKind for a fault code. ChargeStage::Fault is a charger concept and does not apply., VE_REG_BMS_IO, 16-bit IO status — this is where 'allowed to charge', 'allowed to discharge' and the main contactor state live. A cabin rules engine that wants to know whether the bank is even connected has no wire name for it. Largest gap in this entry., VE_REG_BMS_WARNINGS_ALARMS, 18 bits — no MetricKind. Neither Victron nor either community implementation decodes these bits; Fabian-Schmidt/esphome-victron_ble explicitly lists 'Missing definition for error, io_status and warnings_alarms'., Mode / State (BMS operational state, from the manual's parameter table) — no MetricKind., Allowed to charge / Allowed to discharge — no MetricKind, and these are the two booleans that decide whether a rules engine may start a load or a charger at all., Relay status (programmable relay) — switch-state exists but is already the load-output boolean elsewhere in the catalogue; a second output has nowhere to go., Balancer status, min/max cell voltage, min/max cell temperature, individual cell voltages, number of batteries / cells / in series / in parallel — no MetricKind for any of them., Deepest discharge, cumulative Ah drawn, discharged energy, charged energy, synchronisations, number of full discharges, min/max battery voltage, last error — history records, a different contract shape entirely, not new MetricKind variants.
